summary: This guide showcases endgame boss Mekkatorque Phase 2 team setups achieving over 1.5 billion damage. The creator demonstrates that replacing Hvitar with Durango in a Frost core yields superior results due to Durango's defense-shredding talent Biting Erosion. Feenja is strictly mandatory in the lineup to provide resistance-sharing through her Stand United talent. All damage dealers and debuffers require precise tuning of accuracy, resistance, and skill haste to maintain a rigid 15-second skill rotation.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.verdict: Top pick over Hvitar for Mekkatorque Phase 2
heroes.note: His Biting Erosion talent shreds boss defense by 0.5% per stack and provides massive damage amplification when paired with Physio Core talent 8.

heroes.name: Hvitar
heroes.verdict: Viable alternative, but deals less overall team damage than Durango
heroes.note: Used in Chinese server setups for roughly 1.37B to 1.6B damage, but falls behind Durango's defense shredding.

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.note: Essential for her Stand United talent which shares 20% of her high resistance to adjacent front-line allies, preventing boss debuffs.

heroes.name: Aethereal
heroes.note: Requires high Enlightenment, Attack, Attack Speed for her exclusive talent, and skill haste to align with the 15-second rotation.

heroes.name: Lossenia
heroes.note: Built for Attack and Accuracy while sharing Accuracy to allies through the Reverie of Carcass set.

heroes.name: Vinyara
heroes.note: Must be built with full native Accuracy and Resistance since she is positioned out of range of Feenja's resistance-sharing aura.

teams.note: Achieves 1.52B+ damage using a synchronized 15-second skill rotation with Enlightenment Aura; Durango casts at 12.0s, Aethereal at 13.5s, Lossenia at 11.5s, and Vinyara at 12.0s.
Alternative pure Frost composition popularized on Chinese servers hitting around 1.37B to 1.6B damage.

meta_changes: Durango's Biting Erosion defense reduction outperforms traditional Frost damage dealers like Hvitar in high-tier Mekkatorque Phase 2 boss teams.
tips: Mekkatorque Phase 2 recommends roughly 356 Accuracy and 356 Resistance; aim to hit these thresholds across your roster.
Do not swap Feenja for pure offensive buffers like Anselm, because the team will fail without her Stand United resistance sharing.
Place the Lava Batwing pet in the same row/column as Aethereal to trigger the 5-stack Converging Flames damage penetration bonus from Raging Wildfire.
Always run an Enlightenment Aura if accuracy benchmarks are met; switch to an Accuracy Aura only if you cannot hit minimum accuracy on gear.
Maintain strict 15-second skill recast intervals on all ultimate skills to prevent the team from falling out of sync.
